description: Extracts an embedded executable payload from a large C byte array, writes it to disk as payload.exe, and launches it as a separate process.

dropper.role: contains embedded executable bytes, reconstructs the payload on disk, and starts the dropped executable

payload.role: dropped executable payload launched by the dropper

payload_behavior.description: The embedded payload is reconstructed as payload.exe on disk and executed as a standalone process.
expected_actions: write embedded PE bytes to disk

code_placement: Complete executable payload stored as a static unsigned char byte array inside the dropper
execution_trigger: Immediate execution via CreateProcessA after successful file write
execution_target: new local process created from dropped payload.exe

dropper: large embedded unsigned char payload buffer
MZ and PE header bytes visible inside the embedded payload
DOS stub string from embedded PE payload
WriteFile used to write embedded bytes to disk
CreateProcessA used to launch dropped executable
absence of in-memory execution APIs such as VirtualAlloc or CreateThread
payload: valid Windows PE structure embedded inside parent binary

dropper: creates payload.exe in the current working directory
writes embedded payload bytes to payload.exe

creates a new process from payload.exe

payload: payload.exe starts as a child process of the dropper

semantic_meaning: Demonstrates a classic embedded-payload dropper pattern in which a carrier executable stores a complete secondary PE file internally, reconstructs it on disk, and executes it as a separate process.

control_notes.payload_effect: drops and launches a benign calc.exe-derived executable as an execution marker
